law:
"on a weekly chart, old Bullish BOS is breached to the downside. Then we begin looking for a bottom on that beginning fractal ...
   once we can have a swing low kind of fixed in, we then put a 50% on that swing low to the high of that fractal. I want you to find
   me tickers that are Above the old BOS but below the 50% of that fractal. The idea would be me looking at those tickers closer in
   for an entry, but that area is bullish so that's why I'm interested in that area."

As built (MEASURED-ONLY, reads the board + the daily cache, places nothing):
  line     = an old bullish BOS line of the OLD BOS LINES board (weekly close top later closed above - his Oct 31 lesson)
  peak     = the highest daily high after the BOS (the top of the up-leg the decline fell from; LYV: the Aug-2026 high)
  breach   = at least one daily close under the line after the peak (the board's BREACHED, "breached to the downside")
  swing low= the lowest daily low after the peak, "fixed in" once it is at least swing_confirm_days sessions old and the last close
             is back above the line (the bottom is behind us when the line has been reclaimed)
  50%      = (peak + swing low) / 2  - his "0.5 (178.2x) 50% of Fractal" on LYV
  THE ZONE = line < last close < 50%  -> the row. pos = how far up the zone the close sits (0 = on the line, 1 = at the 50%).
  Also kept, not in the zone: ABOVE 50% (reclaimed and already past the half - LYV on Nov 4), so a name that drops back in is seen.
